summary: CI now runs the offline generation-pipeline verifier (`node scripts/verify-c2.mjs`) before any Docker step, then on a clean checkout rewrites MASTER_KEY in the temp .env (sourced only from .env.example, never developer/production .env) to a freshly generated 32-byte hex via `openssl rand -hex 32`, brings the full Compose stack (app + Caddy) up, polls `/api/health` through Caddy at http://127.0.0.1/api/health (≤30×2s), writes a marker into the bind-mounted data volume, restarts `app`, re-polls /api/health, asserts the marker persisted across the restart, and unconditionally `docker compose down -v` plus marker cleanup via an EXIT trap (success or failure). verify-c2.mjs now pins HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY to an unreachable port (`http://127.0.0.1:1`) so localhost reaches the mock LLM while optional public Nominatim geocoding fails fast into its documented null fallback — keeping the offline run deterministic on this host (network status already varies on Windows).
